2. 3. s25 / s26 — INPUTS CORRECTED, DECISIONS UNCHANGED. Both now declare recheckRequired:false and airportChangeRequired:false (one ticket, same airport). WHY: their source is Appendix B.2, whose session has ONE unknown, the bag ("Compass asks exactly one question"; step 5 "if confirmed CHECKED_THROUGH ... landside feasibility is evaluated"). Before #624 an unstated ticket and airport answer read as "no"; after it they are decisive unknowns of their own, so the fixtures stopped representing B.2 and layoverDecisionDiffCheck.test.ts's B.2 case (the same session with the bag confirmed through is evaluated) went red. With both stated, s25 is no / usable 33 / BAGGAGE_STATUS_CRITICAL_UNKNOWN / gate.baggage_unknown and s26 is tight / usable 68 / no gate rule — byte-identical to the previous golden's results; only inputHash and snapshotId moved. Probe on a scratch copy (reverted): stating ONLY recheckRequired:false restores s26's deadline but leaves it NO via gate.airport_change_unknown, so both facts are needed.

WHAT THE PREVIOUS NOTE SAID THAT IS NO LONGER TRUE: s30's "6.1 fails closed only when the unknown could change the verdict, and at 6h it cannot" considered only the bag. The unread set also holds the airport-change answer, which can change any verdict that is not already a refusal.
NO CHANGE IS UNEXPLAINED BY #624; no scenario was held back as a defect.
